titleEn: The Glory of Kings — Reviling the King Is Not Fitting (ch. 44)
part: ch. 44 — Reviling the King Is Not Fitting
about: Chapter 44 argues that a king must not be reviled by his people, since he is God's anointed and God rewards the good king with victory and a throne in heaven and on earth. It then turns to priests, who surpass the prophets and must fearlessly rebuke the king when they have seen his sins, as Samuel did Saul and Elijah Ahab, while the people are not to revile the clergy.

sentences.t: ፵፬ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢመፍትው ፡ ሐምየ ፡ ንጉሥ ።
sentences.l: 44. That not-fitting reviling-of king
sentences.i: Chapter 44: That It Is Not Fitting to Revile a King
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፵፬ is the numeral 44. ከመ introduces a clause ('that'); ኢመፍትው 'not fitting' (ኢ- negates the adjective መፍትው); ሐምየ is an infinitive in the construct before ንጉሥ: 'reviling-of king', an objective genitive (the king is reviled).

sentences.t: ወኢመፍትው ፡ ይሕምይዎ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ እስመ ፡ መሲሑ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ውእቱ ።
sentences.l: And-not-fitting they-revile-him to-king, for anointed-his to-God he.
sentences.i: It is not fitting that anyone should revile the king, for he is God's anointed.
sentences.n: ወ- 'and'; ኢመፍትው 'not fitting'; ይሕምይዎ is a subjunctive (3rd pl. + 3rd m. sg. object -ዎ) of ሐምየ 'revile, slander'; the object is doubled, the suffix -ዎ anticipating it and ለንጉሥ naming it. እስመ 'for, because'. መሲሑ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'his-anointed, to-God' is the Geʿez way of saying 'God's anointed' (a possessive suffix anticipating the owner with ለ-); compare 1 Samuel 24:6 and Psalm 105:15.

sentences.t: ኢመፍትው ፡ ወኢኮነ ፡ ሠናየ ፡ ሐሚዮቱ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፤
sentences.l: Not-fitting and-not-was good reviling-his to-king;
sentences.i: It is not fitting, nor is it good, to revile the king;
sentences.n: ኢኮነ is 'was not' (negated ኮነ, 'to be, become'). ሐሚዮቱ is the same infinitive with 3rd m. sg. suffix, again anticipating the object with ለንጉሥ, 'his reviling, of the king'.

sentences.t: ለእመ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ሠናየ ፡ ኢያሀጒል ፡ እም፫ ፡ መንግሥት ፡ ፩ ፡ ያገርር ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ፀሮ ፡ ወኢያገብኦ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደ ፡ ጸላኢሁ ፤
sentences.l: if he-did good, not-he-destroys from-3 kingdom one: he-subdues for-him his-enemy and-not-he-delivers-him into hand-of his-foe;
sentences.i: if he does good, God does not let him lose one of three kingdoms (?): first, he subdues his enemy for him and does not hand him over into the power of his foe;
sentences.n: ለእመ 'if'. ገብረ 'did, made'; ኢያሀጒል 'he does not destroy/make lose' (causative of ሀጕለ 'perish'; subject understood as God, 'does not let perish', but the clause is compressed and its exact force is uncertain (?)). እም፫ is እም- 'from, of' + the numeral 3 (፫); the three 'kingdoms' (rewards) are enumerated as ፩ (here), ፪, ፫ in this and the next two units. ያገርር 'subdues' (ገረረ, causative); ሎቱ 'for him'. ወኢያገብኦ 'and he does not make him enter/hand him over' (causative of ገብአ 'enter') with object -ኦ. እደ is construct of እድ 'hand'.

sentences.t: ፪ ፡ ወበሰማያትኒ ፡ ያነግሦ ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ጻድቃኒሁ ፡ ወያነብሮ ፡ በየማኑ ፤
sentences.l: 2. and-in-the-heavens-too he-enthrones-him with-him, with his-righteous, and-sets-him at-his-right;
sentences.i: second, in heaven too he makes him reign with himself, with his righteous ones and sets him at his right hand;
sentences.n: ፪ is 'second'. ወበሰማያትኒ: ወ- 'and', በ- 'in', ሰማያት 'heavens', -ኒ 'also, too' (a frequent enclitic). ያነግሦ 'he makes him king' (causative of ነግሠ 'reign'); ምስሌሁ 'with him'; ጻድቃኒሁ 'his righteous ones' (ጻድቅ 'righteous', plural ጻድቃን, here with suffix -ሁ; the ኒ is part of the plural-with-suffix form, not the enclitic 'also'). ያነብሮ 'he seats him' (causative of ነበረ 'sit, dwell'); በየማኑ 'at his right' (የማን 'right hand'). Echoes Psalm 110:1.

sentences.t: ፫ ፡ በዲበ ፡ ምድርኒ ፡ ያነግሦ ፡ በክብር ፡ ወበፍሥሓ ፡ ወያረትዕ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ መንግሥቶ ፡ ወያገርር ፡ አሕዛበ ፡ ታሕተ ፡ እገሪሁ ።
sentences.l: 3. on-upon earth-too he-enthrones-him in-glory and-in-joy, and-makes-straight for-him his-kingdom, and-subdues peoples under his-feet.
sentences.i: third, on earth too he makes him reign in glory and joy, sets his kingdom right for him, and subdues peoples beneath his feet.
sentences.n: በዲበ 'upon' (ዲበ is a preposition, originally a noun 'top'); ምድርኒ 'earth' + -ኒ. ወያረትዕ 'and he makes straight' (causative of ርትዐ 'be straight, right'), here 'sets in order, establishes'. አሕዛበ is the accusative of አሕዛብ 'peoples, nations'; ታሕተ እገሪሁ 'beneath his feet' (cf. Psalm 8:6, 110:1). The accusative ending (-ä, written with the 1st order) marks direct objects, as in አሕዛበ.

sentences.t: ወእመሰ ፡ ተዐወሮ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወኢገብረ ፡ ሠናየ ፡ ወኢ ፡ ሖረ ፡ በፍኖት ፡ ርትዕት ፡ ለሊሁ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ይገብር ፡ በከመ ፡ ፈቀደ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ወበዲበ ፡ ምድርኒ ፡ ያሐጽጽ ፡ መዋዕሊሁ ፡ ወበሰማያትኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ማኅደረ ፡ ሲኦል ፡ ምስለ ፡ ዲያብሎስ ፡ ማኅደሩ ፤
sentences.l: And-if-indeed he-was-hardened(?) against-God and-not-did good and-not walked in-way straight, himself God he-does as he-wished upon-him: and-upon earth-too he-shortens his-days, and-in-the-heavens-too, into dwelling-of Sheol with the-Devil his-dwelling;
sentences.i: But if he is stubborn (?) against God, does no good, and does not walk in the straight way, God himself will do to him as he wishes: on earth he will shorten his days, and in the afterlife his dwelling will be the abode of Sheol, with the Devil;
sentences.n: ወእመሰ: ወ- 'and' + እመ 'if' + -ሰ (a contrastive enclitic, 'but if'). ተዐወሮ is a passive/reflexive stem (ተ-) with object suffix; the root is uncertain: perhaps from ዐወረ 'be blind' (?), so 'was blind/hardened toward', or 'opposed' (?); I read 'was hardened against', as in `l`. ወኢ ፡ ሖረ: the wordspace splits ኢ from ሖረ 'walked' (printing quirk; read ወኢሖረ). ፍኖት 'way', ርትዕት 'straight, right' (fem. adjective). ለሊሁ 'himself'. ይገብር 'does, will do' (imperfect, not subjunctive, which would be ይግበር); በከመ 'as, according as'; ፈቀደ 'wished'; ላዕሌሁ 'upon him'. ያሐጽጽ 'he makes short' (causative of ሐጸጸ). መዋዕሊሁ 'his days'. 'In the heavens' is odd here and must mean the next world; ማኅደረ ሲኦል 'dwelling-of Sheol' is a construct chain. ዲያብሎስ the Devil. Final ማኅደሩ 'his dwelling' resumes the clause.

sentences.t: ወበዲበ ፡ ምድርኒ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ጥዕና ፡ ወፍሥሓ ፡ ልብ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ድንጋፄ ፡ ወፍርሀት ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ሰላም ፡ በሁከት ፨
sentences.l: and-upon earth-too without health and-joy-of heart, with dread and-fear, without peace in-turmoil.
sentences.i: and on earth he will live without health or gladness of heart, in dread and fear, without peace, in turmoil.
sentences.n: ዘእንበለ 'without' (lit. 'that-not-before'); the series ጥዕና 'health', ፍሥሓ ልብ 'joy-of heart' (construct), ድንጋፄ 'dread, terror', ፍርሀት 'fear'. ምስለ 'with'; በሁከት 'in turmoil, confusion'. The verb is understood from the previous unit. Ends in ፨, here a section mark closing the first part of the argument.

sentences.t: ኢኮነ ፡ ሠናየ ፡ ሐሚዮቱ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ እምሕዝብ ፡ እለ ፡ እምታሕቴሁ ፡ እስመ ፡ ፍዳ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ውእቱ ፤
sentences.l: Not-was good reviling-his to-king by-the-people who under-him, for requital to-God he;
sentences.i: It is not good for the people under a king to revile him, for he is God's requital (?);
sentences.n: እምሕዝብ: እም- 'from, by' + ሕዝብ 'people'; እለ 'who' (plural relative); እምታሕቴሁ 'from under him'. The sense of ፍዳ ለእግዚኣብሔር ውእቱ is uncertain (?): ፍዳ is 'recompense, requital, punishment', so 'the king is God's requital', i.e. the instrument of God's judgment on the people, which is why they should not revile him. Or ፍዳ is the subject and ለእግዚኣብሔር the predicate, 'requital is God's' (cf. Deuteronomy 32:35; Romans 12:19) (?).

sentences.t: ወባሕቱ ፡ ካህናትሰ ፡ አምሳለ ፡ ነቢያት ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ወባሕቱ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ ይኄይሱ ፡ እምነቢያት ፡ እስመ ፡ ተውህቦሙ ፡ ምሥጢራት ፡ ከመ ፡ ይእኅዙ ፡ ፀሐየ ፡ ጽድቅ ፤
sentences.l: but priests, likenesses-of prophets they; and-yet far they-surpass beyond-prophets, for were-given-to-them mysteries that they-may-hold the-sun-of righteousness;
sentences.i: The priests are likenesses of the prophets, yet they surpass the prophets by far, for the mysteries were given to them, that they might hold the sun of righteousness;
sentences.n: ወባሕቱ 'but, yet'; ካህናትሰ with -ሰ 'as for'. አምሳለ is the construct of አምሳል 'likeness' before ነቢያት 'prophets'. ፈድፋደ 'exceedingly, far more'; ይኄይሱ 'they are better' (ኀየሰ 'be good, be better', comparative with እም- 'than'). ተውህቦሙ 'was given to them' (passive of ወሀበ 'give'). ምሥጢራት 'mysteries' (here perhaps the sacraments). ይእኅዙ 'they may hold' (subjunctive of አኀዘ 'seize, hold'). ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'sun of righteousness' is Malachi 4:2 (3:20), taken of Christ, as in the next lines.

sentences.t: ሱራፌል ፡ እለ ፡ ተፈጥሩ ፡ እምእሳት ፡ ዘኢይክሉ ፡ እኂዘ ፡ ምሥጢራት ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ በጕጠታት ።
sentences.l: The-seraphim, who were-created from-fire, who-cannot to-hold mysteries except with-tongs.
sentences.i: The Seraphim, who were created from fire, cannot take hold of the mysteries except with tongs.
sentences.n: ሱራፌል 'seraphim' (Hebrew שרפים with final -ል for -ם, as in ኪሩቤል 'cherubim'; used as a plural). ተፈጥሩ 'were created' (passive of ፈጠረ). ዘኢይክሉ 'who cannot' (ዘ- relative + ኢ- + ይክሉ 'they are able'); እኂዘ infinitive 'to hold'. ጕጠታት 'tongs' (plural), recalling Isaiah 6:6, where a seraph takes the coal with tongs. The point: priests handle by hand what even seraphs cannot.

sentences.t: ለካህናትሰ ፡ ሰመዮሙ ፡ ፄወ ፤
sentences.l: To-the-priests-indeed he-named-them salt(?);
sentences.i: He named the priests salt (?);
sentences.n: ለካህናትሰ: ለ- marks the object, -ሰ is contrastive. ሰመዮሙ 'he named them' (ሰመየ 'name', with object -ሙ). ፄወ: I read this as 'salt' (ጼው, here spelled with the ፀ-series ፄ, the two ṣ-series being often confused), accusative (ጼው + -a); compare Matthew 5:13, 'You are the salt of the earth' (?). The 'he' is Christ (Matthew 5:13–16), who also does the naming in the next three units.

sentences.t: ወዓዲ ፡ ለካህናት ፡ ሰመዮሙ ፡ ማኅቶተ ፤
sentences.l: and-again to-priests he-named-them a-lamp;
sentences.i: and again he named the priests a lamp;
sentences.n: ወዓዲ 'and again, moreover'. ማኅቶተ accusative of ማኅቶት 'lamp'; compare Matthew 5:15.

sentences.t: ካዕበ ፡ ሰመዮሙ ፡ ብርሃኖ ፡ ለዓለም ፤
sentences.l: again he-named-them light-his to-the-world;
sentences.i: again he named them the light of the world;
sentences.n: ካዕበ 'again, a second time'. ብርሃኖ is ብርሃን 'light' + the 3ms suffix in its accusative form (-o), 'his light'; with ለዓለም it follows the pattern seen in መሲሑ ለእግዚኣብሔር: the suffix anticipates the owner, 'its light, the world's', i.e. 'the light of the world' (Matthew 5:14).

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ሰመዮሙ ፡ ፀሐየ ፡ ዘያበርህ ፡ ጽልመተ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ፀሐየ ፡ ጽድቅ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አልባቢሆሙ ።
sentences.l: and-again he-named-them a-sun that illumines darkness, while Christ, sun-of righteousness, is in their-hearts.
sentences.i: and once more he named them a sun that lights up the darkness, while Christ, the sun of righteousness, is in their hearts.
sentences.n: ዘያበርህ 'that makes bright' (causative of በርሀ 'shine'); ጽልመተ accusative of ጽልመት 'darkness'. እንዘ introduces a circumstantial clause here with a nominal predicate (Christ ... in their hearts), 'while'. አልባቢሆሙ 'their hearts' (broken plural of ልብ). ክርስቶስ ፀሐየ ጽድቅ: see Malachi 4:2.

sentences.t: ወካህንሰ ፡ ዘቦቱ ፡ ልቡና ፡ ይገሥጾ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ምግባራተ ፡ ዘርእየ ፤
sentences.l: And-the-priest indeed, who has-in-him understanding, rebukes the-king concerning deeds-of what he-saw;
sentences.i: A priest who has understanding rebukes the king for the deeds he has seen;
sentences.n: ዘቦቱ ልቡና 'who has understanding' (ዘ- 'who' + ቦቱ 'in him / he has'). ይገሥጾ 'he rebukes him' (ገሠጸ 'rebuke, admonish', with object -ኦ contracted). ምግባራተ 'deeds, works', plural in the construct form (-ተ) before the ዘ- clause; ዘርእየ 'what he saw'. ይገሥጾ is the imperfect (ይገሥጽ) + -ኦ. Note that ገሠጸ is the key verb of the chapter.

sentences.t: ወዘኢርእየሰ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ይፈትን ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘይወቅሶ ።
sentences.l: and-what-he-did-not-see God tests; and there-is-not who blames-him.
sentences.i: and what he has not seen, God tests; and there is no one to blame him.
sentences.n: ወዘኢርእየሰ 'and what he did not see' (ዘ- relative + ኢ- negation). ይፈትን 'he tests, tries'; አልቦ 'there is not'; ዘይወቅሶ 'who blames him', (ወቀሰ 'blame, reproach'). The priest is not blamed for what he could not see (?); the referent of the object -ኦ (written -ሶ with the verb's ሰ) is not certain.

sentences.t: ወዓዲ ፡ ኢይሕምይዎሙ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ለጳጳሳት ፡ ወለካህናት ፤
sentences.l: And-again let-not-revile-them peoples to-bishops and-to-priests;
sentences.i: Again, the peoples should not revile bishops and priests;
sentences.n: ኢይሕምይዎሙ is a negative jussive, 'let them not revile them' (ኢ- + ይሕምይዎሙ with object -ሙ). ጳጳሳት 'bishops' (Greek papas, plural). ወለካህናት: ወ- and ለ-, the object marker again.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወሰብአ ፡ ቤቱ ፡ እሙንቱ ፤
sentences.l: for sons-of God and men-of his-house they;
sentences.i: for they are sons of God and members of his household;
sentences.n: ደቂቀ is the construct of ደቂቅ 'sons, children'. ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men-of his-house', a construct chain, 'his household' (cf. Ephesians 2:19). እሙንቱ 'they (are)' the plural copula-pronoun.

sentences.t: በእንተ ፡ ዘገሠጽዎሙ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ ፡ ወጌጋዮሙ ።
sentences.l: because they-rebuked them concerning their-sin and-their-error.
sentences.i: because they rebuked them for their sin and their error (?).
sentences.n: በእንተ ዘገሠጽዎሙ 'on account of what they rebuked them' (ዘ- relative, 3rd pl. perfect with object -ሙ); read as 'because they rebuked them'. ኀጢአቶሙ 'their sin' and ጌጋዮሙ 'their error' with suffixes -ሙ. The punctuation ። ends this sentence, but it is grammatically a tail of the previous one (?).

sentences.t: ወአንተኒ ፡ ኦካህን ፡ ለእመ ፡ ርኢከ ፡ ዕዉቀ ፡ ኀጢአቶ ፡ ለብእሲ ፡ ኢትኅፈር ፡ ገሥጾቶ ፡ ኢያፍርህከ ፡ ሰይፍ ፡ ወኢስደት ፤
sentences.l: And-you-too, O priest, if you-saw known his-sin to-a-man, be-not-ashamed to-rebuke him; let-not frighten-you sword nor persecution;
sentences.i: You also, O priest: if you see a man's sin to be plainly known, do not be ashamed to rebuke him, and let neither sword nor persecution frighten you;
sentences.n: ወአንተኒ 'and you too'; ኦካህን vocative 'O priest'. ለእመ ርኢከ 'if you saw/see'. ዕዉቀ is the passive participle of ዐወቀ 'know', here 'known' and in the accusative (a predicate of ኀጢአቶ). ኢትኅፈር 'do not be ashamed'; ገሥጾቶ 'to rebuke him' (infinitive with suffix). ኢያፍርህከ 'let it not frighten you' (causative of ፈርሀ 'fear', with 2nd m. object -ከ). ሰይፍ 'sword', ስደት 'persecution'.

sentences.t: ወስማዕ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ተምዕዖ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለኢሳይያስ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዖዝያንንጉሥ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኢገሠጾ ፤
sentences.l: And-hear how was-angry God with-Isaiah concerning Uzziah-king, because he-did-not-rebuke him;
sentences.i: And hear how God was angry with Isaiah over King Uzziah, because he did not rebuke him;
sentences.n: ስማዕ 'hear!' (imperative). ዘከመ 'how, in what manner'. ተምዕዖ 'was angry with' (ተምዕዐ, with ለ-). ዖዝያንንጉሥ is written as one word in the source: ዖዝያን 'Uzziah' + ንጉሥ 'king', the final ን of the first and the initial ን of the second standing side by side (nothing is extra). I do not know the source of the story that Isaiah failed to rebuke Uzziah (?); it is not in Isaiah itself (cf. 2 Chronicles 26, Isaiah 6:1).

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ስማዕ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ሳሙኤል ፡ ነቢይ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ገሠጾ ፡ ለሳኦል ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ኢየኀፍሮ ፡ ወሠጠጠ ፡ መንግሥቶ ፡ በነገሩ ፤
sentences.l: and-again hear concerning Samuel the-prophet how he-rebuked Saul the-king, without being-ashamed-of-him, and-tore his-kingdom by-his-word;
sentences.i: and hear again about the prophet Samuel, how he rebuked King Saul without being ashamed before him, and tore his kingdom away by his word;
sentences.n: ካዕበ ስማዕ 'again hear'. ነቢይ 'prophet'. ሳኦል Saul, ሳሙኤል Samuel (1 Samuel 13:13–14, 15:23–28). እንዘ ኢየኀፍሮ 'while not being ashamed of him'. ሠጠጠ 'tore, split' (cf. 1 Samuel 15:28, 'the Lord has torn the kingdom from you'). በነገሩ 'by his word' (ነገር 'word, speech').

sentences.t: ወኤልያስኒ ፡ ለአከአብ ፤
sentences.l: and-Elijah-too to-Ahab;
sentences.i: and Elijah too rebuked Ahab;
sentences.n: ኤልያስ Elijah, አከአብ Ahab (1 Kings 21:17–24). The verb 'rebuked' is understood from the previous unit.

sentences.t: ወአንተኒ ፡ ኢትኅፈር ፡ ገሥጾ ፡ ወመሀሮ ፡ ለዘ ፡ ይኤብስ ።
sentences.l: and-you-too be-not-ashamed to-rebuke and-to-teach him who is-stubborn(?).
sentences.i: and you also, do not be ashamed to rebuke and teach the one who is stubborn (?).
sentences.n: ገሥጾ and መሀሮ (መሀረ 'teach') are ambiguous: infinitives, 'to rebuke, to teach', or imperatives with -ኦ 'him', 'rebuke him, teach him!', the object then doubled by ለዘ ይኤብስ; I read infinitives (?). Here the wordspace ለዘ ፡ ይኤብስ splits the relative ዘ from its verb, read ለዘይኤብስ. ይኤብስ is uncertain (?): as with ይኤብሱ in chapter 42 the root is unclear; the context ('rebuke and teach') suggests 'is stubborn, obstinate', 'the stubborn' (?).

sentences.t: ወእስራኤልሰ ፡ እምትካት ፡ የሐምዩ ፡ ንጉሦሙ ፡ ወያምዕዑ ፡ ነቢያቲሆሙ ፡ ወድኅረሰ ፡ ሰቀሉ ፡ መድኀኒሆሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-Israel-indeed from-of-old(?) they-revile their-king and-they-provoke their-prophets, and-in-the-end crucified their-saviour;
sentences.i: Israel, from of old (?), reviled its king and provoked its prophets to anger, and in the end crucified its Saviour;
sentences.n: ወእስራኤልሰ 'as for Israel'. እምትካት is uncertain (?): ትካት is glossed in chapter 30 (ዘትካት) as 'establishment, foundation' (?), so እምትካት may be 'from the foundation, from of old'; I take it as 'from of old, from the first'. የሐምዩ 'they revile' (ሐምየ); ያምዕዑ 'they provoke to anger' (አምዐ 'make angry', the causative counterpart of ተምዕዐ 'be angry'), ነቢያቲሆሙ 'their prophets'. ድኅረሰ 'afterwards, finally'. ሰቀሉ 'they hanged/crucified'; መድኀኒሆሙ 'their saviour' (agent noun from አድኀነ 'save', root ድኅነ 'be saved'), i.e. Christ.

sentences.t: ወሕዝበ ፡ ክርስቲያንሰ ፡ መሀይምናን ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ በሰላም ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ደዌ ፡ ወሕማም ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ጽልእ ፡ ወማዕቀፍ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ንጉሥነ ፡ እገሌ ፡ መፍቀሬ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ እንዘ ፡ ኢያአትት ፡ እምልቡ ፡ ነገረ ፡ ጽድቅ ፡ ወሃይማኖት ፡ በእንተ ፡ አብያተ ፡ ክርስቲያናት ፡ ወመሀይምናን ፡ ወፀሩኒ ፡ ግሩራን ፡ በኀይለ ፡ መስቀሉ ፡ ለኢየሱስ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: and the-people-of Christians-indeed, the-faithful, dwell in-peace without sickness and-suffering, without hatred and-constraint(?), with our-king so-and-so, lover-of God, while he-does-not-remove from-his-heart words-of righteousness and-faith, for-the-sake-of churches and-the-faithful; and his-enemies-too (are) subdued by-the-power-of cross-his to-Jesus Christ.
sentences.i: But the Christian people, the faithful, live in peace, without sickness or suffering, without hatred or constraint (?), together with our king, N., a lover of God, while he does not put away from his heart the words of righteousness and faith, for the sake of the churches and the faithful; and his enemies too are subdued by the power of the cross of Jesus Christ.
sentences.n: ሕዝበ ክርስቲያን 'people-of Christians', a construct chain; the verb ይነብሩ 'they dwell' (ነበረ). ማዕቀፍ is uncertain (?): from ዐቀፈ 'embrace, hold', perhaps 'oppression, restraint', or 'enclosure, siege' (?). እገሌ 'so-and-so', presumably a placeholder where the name of the reigning king is to be inserted when the text is read aloud. መፍቀሬ እግዚኣብሔር 'lover-of God' (agent noun of ፈቀረ + construct). ኢያአትት 'does not remove': the same verb as ወያአትት in chapter 27 (አአተተ; the stem is not well known (?)). ነገረ ጽድቅ 'word-of righteousness'; ሃይማኖት 'faith'; አብያተ ክርስቲያናት 'houses-of Christians', i.e. churches. ፀሩኒ ግሩራን: ፀሩኒ is ፀር 'enemy' + the suffix -ሁ (ፀሩ, 'his enemies', a collective) + -ኒ 'also'; the ending -ሩ cannot be a plural, so I read 'his' (the king's) rather than a bare 'enemies' (?). ግሩራን 'subdued' (passive participle of ገረረ, as ያገርር above) has the plural ending -ን. በኀይለ መስቀሉ ለኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ 'by the power of the cross of Jesus Christ' (the ለ- possessive again). The chapter ends with a run of ፨ marks.
